title: Potatoes from Planting to Harvesting Cycle Spring to Fall

tasks.task_text: Describe the seasonal process of potato farming.

subtasks.task_text: Describe the seasonal process of potato farming.
subtasks.text: Observe the start of planting potato crops in the middle of April.

subtasks.task_text: Describe the seasonal process of potato farming.
subtasks.text: Note the duration of planting potato crops, which takes four to six weeks.

subtasks.task_text: Describe the seasonal process of potato farming.
subtasks.text: Watch the irrigation process to keep the crops healthy when it's dry.
Observe the harvesting process starting from the first of August.
Notice the continuation of harvesting until the middle of October.
Observe the maintenance and equipment check activities in the wintertime.
Watch the variety of equipment that needs to be checked.
